title: Tuning the electrical and optical performance of PVA/PANI films via Fe2O3 nanorods for advanced energy storage and optoelectronic devices
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17676-17689
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01666A, Paper
Open Access

H. M. Ragab, N. S. Diab, Rosilah Ab Aziz, Shimaa Mohammed Aboelnaga, A. Al Ojeery, Tahani M. Alresheedi, M. O. Farea
PVA/PANI-Fe2O3 nanocomposite films were successfully fabricated via a solution casting method with Fe2O3 nanorod loadings ranging from 1.0 to 4.5 wt% to tailor their structural, optical, and electrical properties for optoelectronic applications.
